The problem with legacy analytics

For nearly two decades, Google Analytics and complex enterprise trackers monopolized the web. In exchange for free dashboards, companies forced their visitors to download 45KB+ tracking libraries, consented to surveillance capitalism, and cluttered their websites with annoying cookie banners.

To make matters worse, modern GA4 turned basic reporting into a labyrinth of nested exploration menus, introduced strict 14-month data retention limits, and offered zero direct attribution to real payment receipts from Stripe or Paddle.

Heavy browser bloat slowing page load
Mandatory cookie consent popups and Data Privacy Act (RA 10173) risk
Vanity time clock punches disconnected from actual revenue

Why we built ClockTime

We built ClockTime to give founders and teams an uncompromising alternative. A modern web analytics platform that is lightning-fast, respect-driven, and designed specifically for products that sell subscriptions, software, or digital goods.

ClockTime does not collect personally identifiable information (PII), generates zero persistent tracking cookies, and runs on an ultra-lightweight script weighing under 1KB. Most importantly, it connects directly to your payment gateways to tell you which marketing channels generate real revenue.

Under 1KB script running on global edge CDNs
100% cookieless tracking — no consent banners required
Automated Stripe, Polar & Paddle revenue matching
Our Core Principles

What we believe in

The non-negotiable principles that guide every feature we build and every decision we make.

Privacy is a Human Right

We never track individual human beings across the web, sell user telemetry to data brokers, or use invasive device fingerprinting. Your users' privacy is sacrosanct.

Extreme Performance & Speed

Every millisecond of latency costs conversions. Our script is compiled to < 1KB and deployed on edge nodes in over 300 global cities for zero performance penalty.

Revenue Over Vanity Clicks

A million time clock punches that result in zero customers is noise. We tie every acquisition channel, UTM tag, and referrer to actual financial revenue in your bank.

Open, Modern Developer Tooling

From native MCP servers for Cursor and VS Code to full REST API access and single-line script embeds, we build developer tools that seamlessly fit your stack.

Infrastructure & Ethics

Engineered for privacy and trust

Transparent business model, ethical data handling, and world-class infrastructure.

100% European & Global Edge

Data processed locally on privacy-compliant edge servers with strict Data Privacy Act (RA 10173) & CCPA adherence.

Zero Third-Party Ad Networks

We operate on subscription revenue from customers. We never monetize, share, or sell user data.

Real-Time Aggregation Engine

Clickhouse-backed columnar analytics delivering queries in under 50ms across millions of events.
